model.state_coordinates: physical unnormalized moving variation; h1 sine(4j phi), h2 cosine(4j phi) including its true mean
model.background_coordinates: moving phi: u=alpha*U; v=1/Cref_nu+alpha*V; theta_phi=v/mean_phi(v); B=u/v; C=1/v
model.parameter_source_convention: D h = (+ partial_nu F) delta_nu + f

identity.radial_method: fourth-order two-Gauss Magnus exponential then complete positive-diagonal QR

physical_boundary_description.waist_rows: u sine amplitudes, then physical C4 amplitude
physical_boundary_description.outer_rows: physical C mean, then physical Robin amplitudes j=2..N
physical_boundary_description.outer_inverse_rows: physical C mean and every physical Robin amplitude j=1..N
physical_boundary_description.scalar_output: physical C4 amplitude at the waist
